title: Scoping Review Protocol: Medical Simulation Manikin Adaptation for Robotic Applications
author: Nabil Zary
materials: Reviewer Team Three independent reviewers screen all records.

steps.title: Define Eligibility Criteria
steps.instruction: Establish inclusion and exclusion criteria for studies regarding the adaptation of medical simulation manikins for robotic applications.

substeps.instruction: Include studies describing hardware modifications (sensors, actuators, musculoskeletal/structural changes), software integration (control architectures, AI/ML, ROS, teleoperation), or hybrid approaches (physical manikins with digital interfaces/mixed reality).
Apply inclusion limits: All study designs eligible, no date restriction, English-language publications only.

Apply exclusion codes: E1 (Duplicates), E2 (No robotic adaptation), E3 (Off-topic), E4 (Non-manikin based), E5 (Virtual only), E6 (Non-English), E7 (Editorials/commentaries without technical content), E8 (Conference abstracts without full-text).

steps.title: Design and Execute Search Strategy
steps.instruction: Perform a systematic literature search across six databases using defined concept blocks and database-specific syntax.

substeps.instruction: Search PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and Embase.
Combine three concept blocks using Boolean AND: Block 1 (Medical simulation platforms), Block 2 (Robotics adaptation), and Block 3 (Technical integration).
Adapt Boolean strings using database tags: PubMed [tiab]; Scopus TITLE-ABS-KEY; Web of Science TS; IEEE Xplore free-text; ACM Digital Library free-text; Embase ti,ab,kw.
Execute search without date or publication type filters and export all records regardless of relevance score.
Record search date and number of records retrieved.
Validate results by confirming the presence of known landmark papers.

steps.title: Screen and Select Studies
steps.instruction: Independently screen records and apply consensus rules to determine final study inclusion.

substeps.instruction: Reviewers independently read titles and abstracts, classifying papers as Include, Exclude, or Maybe, and recording rationales/exclusion codes (E1–E8).
Apply consensus rules: Include if $\ge 2/3$ reviewers agree; Exclude if $\ge 2/3$ reviewers agree; 'Maybe' by majority are retained as included; resolve discordant cases via group discussion.
Calculate inter-rater reliability: Fleiss' kappa, pairwise percent agreement, three-way agreement, and Prevalence-Adjusted Bias-Adjusted Kappa (PABAK = 2Po – 1).
Perform sensitivity analysis by identifying studies included by majority but not unanimously, and those classified as 'Maybe', then confirm eligibility via discussion.

steps.title: Develop Analytical Framework
steps.instruction: Classify included studies into technological domains based on their primary contribution.

substeps.instruction: Assign each study to one of three domains: Hardware (physical modification), Software (digital/control innovation), or Hybrid (equal emphasis on both).
Two reviewers independently classify studies, recording the domain, a confidence rating (high, moderate, low), and justification.
Resolve disagreements via consensus; perform full-text review for low-confidence cases.
Perform sensitivity analysis by comparing the domain distribution of high-confidence classifications against the full dataset.

steps.title: Chart the Data
steps.instruction: Extract standardized data from the selected studies using a validated charting form.

substeps.instruction: Develop a form to extract: Author(s), Publication year, Country (first author), Journal/Conference, Study design, Domain, Clinical application domain (assigned inductively), and Manikin/simulator type.
Pilot-test the form on 10 studies and revise as necessary.
Recover missing abstracts via primary search platforms, PubMed E-utilities API, or manual retrieval (institutional library, author contact, open-access repositories) to achieve 100% coverage.

steps.title: Synthesise Results
steps.instruction: Analyze the charted data to answer the research questions through numerical and narrative synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Create descriptive numerical summaries tabulating studies by domain, year, geography, design, clinical area, and technology type.
Generate cross-tabulations: Domain $\times$ publication period (Table 2) and Domain $\times$ clinical application area (Figure 3).

Assess convergence (RQ3) by examining disciplinary asymmetry (hardware-to-software ratio), adoption of AI/ML and ROS, venue fragmentation, cross-domain clinical coverage, and Hybrid domain trajectories.
Conduct narrative thematic analysis addressing RQ1 (nature/extent), RQ2 (trends/patterns), and RQ3 (convergence indicators).
Report sensitivity analysis results for inclusion thresholds and domain classification confidence.

steps.title: Report Findings
steps.instruction: Prepare the final manuscript following PRISMA-ScR guidelines and register the protocol.

substeps.instruction: Include all 22 PRISMA-ScR checklist items, including a structured abstract, flow diagram (Figure 1), complete search strategy (Additional file 1), checklist (Additional file 3), and data charting form (Additional file 2).
Include mandatory declarations: Ethics/consent (N/A), data availability, competing interests, funding, author contributions, and registration status.
Register the protocol on protocols.io and cite the DOI in the manuscript.
